title: Close independent L2 R2 risks on CAP-INV-004 pivot HTTP drafts
goal: Preserve authorized Event Inspector read behavior while making pivot draft a distinct host-authorized action, rejecting ambiguous multi-origin source provenance and applying the same Inspector payload/field bounds.
invariants: Original frozen #186 SHA 7514699e66b1c5fe27a448539ca5bd39aa855cb5 is not modified; correction is a separate stacked PR.
Host-provided pivot permission is DISTINCT from Event.read or visible value, is checked per action after independent Search/Telemetry owner checks, and fail-closed if not configured.
No second policy engine: host injects existing trusted capability permission decision, never from request JSON.
Reject ambiguous same field-value mapped to more than one origin rather than invent first-match provenance.
Reuse existing Inspector serialization validation for all field maps, enrichment counts and raw/rendered payload; selected value <=4096 bytes.
Do not persist or execute a Query; no new IAM backend or client-controlled return context.
security_properties: Pivot endpoint never returns draft on missing/denied/failing pivot-specific authorization; existing Inspector POST remains readable.
Raw-denied data is not promoted; no ambiguous field origin or oversized value escapes as pivot.
No raw payload, tenant metadata or source-field leak on 404.

migration.rationale: Read-only host constructor opt-in and validation; no data migration

rollback.strategy: Revert correction PR; original core and source owner unchanged

inputs: Independent L2 #186 CHANGES_REQUIRED findings F-01 R2 ambiguous provenance, F-02 R2 pivot permission distinct from read, F-03 R2 Inspector/Pivot bounds mismatch
Frozen owner-authorized Go HTTP runtime #186 and source-identical corrected core from #182
outputs: Optional explicit PivotAuthorizer host injection, default NewHandler pivots fail closed but reads remain supported
Ambiguous same field/value origin is rejected before copy
Shared browser projection bounds enforced on pivot
acceptance_tests: Legacy NewHandler without pivot authority denies pivot but preserves read.
Action-specific provider deny/error blocks draft even when Search and Telemetry reads succeed; allow then succeeds.
Multiple matching origins (source+normalized, two enrichment producers) rejected with no arbitrary origin.
Value >4096 or owner projection maps violating Inspector bounds reject pivot without a partial result.
Original host/core regression plus engineering security gates and cross-platform CI success on exact HEAD.
definition_of_ready: Parent I IMPLEMENTED, distinct actions available for host integration, no change to frozen PR
definition_of_done: Source-backed host explicitly checks pivot action and provenance before producing draft
No mandatory security gate softened, exact SHA CI green and independent review when material
No acceptance/production claim before merge and native approvals

performance_budget.rationale: Bounded existing 8KiB request, one extra host permission check, O(64*256) maximum field-origin inspection; no production SLO
